property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This is the Channel being described by this entry in the list of Channels. Channel numbering starts on the first channel on the first Group in the Function Block and continues across Groups in the Function Block. For example, if a Function Block contains 3 Groups it has Channels 1-48 An optional Cluster may exist, associated with the "channel".

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: The name of the Program currently active on this Channel.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This is a 3 item array containing the Bank MSB, Bank LSB and Program Change [MSB, LSB, PC] for the current Program.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This is the starting Channel of The Cluster. Channel Cluster is always described by the lowest Channel.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This is the length of the Channel Cluster including the "clusterChannelStart".

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This is the MIDI Mode of the Cluster

property.name: midi.doc

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This declares if this is the Basic Channel for the Channel Cluster. If the Device is operating on multiple Channels which belong to the Channel Cluster, then MIDI messages sent to this channel set some parameters across multiple channels of the Channel Cluster which belong to the same.

property.name: midi.doc

property.name: midi.doc

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: Human-readable name of the Active Controller Message, pertaining to the effect of recognized messages or the physical interface generating messages. This may be displayed to the user by a connected device.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: Human-readable description of the effect of recognized messages or the physical interface generating messages. This may be displayed to the user by a connected device.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: Type of Controller Message.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This is an array of the Controller Message index numbers. For (N)RPN this will be the Bank (MSB) and Index (LSB). For CC this would mostly be just a single item for the CC, however this can be a pair of MSB and LSB to have 14bit CC messages.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This is the Channel being described by this entry in the list of Active Controllers.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: A value of 1 is the most important, descending down to 5 as the least important. When entries are sent in the CtrlList Resource array, they should be ordered by the "priority" Property. Initiators should use the ordering of the CtrlList Resource to complement the priority given. The Initiator may decide the best way to display or handle entries based on priority

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: The default value if entry is reset. Values declared in unsigned 32 bit values

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: Declares whether this entry supports absolute values, relative values using Relative Registered/Assignable Controllers, both, or none. If not given, the Device only transmits using absolute values.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: Declares whether this entry supports absolute values, relative values using Relative Registered/Assignable Controllers, both, or none. If not given, the Device only recognizes using absolute values

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: Number of significant bits used for the 32 bit values. 32, if not provided.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: The Parameter Path indicates the grouping and display of Active Controller Messages,

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: Provides a hint as to what physical (or displayed) control mechanism should be used on the Initiator to generate the Active Controller Messages.

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: This Property provides the "resId" that shall be used with a CtrlMapList Resource. Subsequently, the CtrlMapList Resource provides a set of enumerated values for the Active Controller Message

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: If Active Controller Message only supports a discrete number of steps, set this value to declare the number of steps. Refer to Stepped Values and Enumerations in Resolution and Bit Scaling Recommended Practice

property.name: midi.doc
property.value: When a Responder recognizes an Active Controller Message within a limited range of the possible values, it may declare the minimum and maximum values recognized. Values declared in unsigned 32 bit values.

property.name: midi.doc
